info.title: Improvado Public Agent Ask API
info.description: Free public plain-text question endpoint for AI agents. Ask a question and get a cited answer about marketing data architecture, connectors, pipelines, attribution, and MCP design. This endpoint is open and does not require authentication.

post.summary: Ask a plain-text question and receive a cited plain-text answer

text/plain.example:
Page: https://improvado.io/blog/marketing-channels 
Question: Which ad platforms does Improvado support natively?

200.description: Plain-text cited answer including a request id and optional continuation URL

429.description: Rate limited. Abusive or automated bulk traffic may be throttled; retry later.
